topics.topic: Scope of Expert Retention and Testimony
topics.evidence: The witness discusses being retained as an expert witness and details the scope of her expected trial testimony regarding ITT Institute, the 90/10 rule, and PEAKS loan program documents as outlined in her expert report.

topics.topic: Witness Professional Background and CV
topics.evidence: Counsel begins questioning the witness regarding her background as an attorney and transitions to reviewing her curriculum vitae.

topics.topic: Witness Professional Background and Role at Student Borrower Protection Center
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding the witness's background as an attorney and her responsibilities, policy agenda, and advocacy work as Deputy Executive Director of the Student Borrower Protection Center.

topics.topic: Overview of student loan policy research and target audiences
topics.evidence: The witness describes analyzing higher education and consumer protection laws, drafting policy memos, and directing initiatives toward regulators, policymakers, and government agencies.

topics.topic: Successful policy and regulatory initiatives
topics.evidence: The witness details specific successful policy efforts, including debt cancellation advocacy, income-driven repayment rules, Department of Education rulemaking negotiations, tax exemptions on canceled loans, and CARES Act provisions.

topics.topic: Initiatives and comments regarding student loan servicers
topics.evidence: The witness discusses submitting public comments, participating in RFIs, and advocating for consumer protections in Department of Education contracts with student loan servicers.

topics.topic: Comments on Department of Education Student Loan Servicing Contracts
topics.evidence: The witness details providing input, comments, and listening session feedback regarding consumer protections, oversight, and administrative requirements for federal student loan servicing contracts.

topics.topic: Witness Professional Background and Experience in Loan Servicing
topics.evidence: The questioning covers the witness's work history, legal aid background, research at the National Consumer Law Center, and testimony before congressional committees on student loan servicing.

topics.topic: Experience and Knowledge Regarding Loan Portfolio Transfers Between Servicers
topics.evidence: The witness discusses past instances and examples of student loan portfolio transfers between servicers, including transitions involving Navient, Aidvantage, PHEAA, and Mohela.

topics.topic: Student Loan Servicing Transfers, Process Risks, and Regulations
topics.evidence: The witness discusses student loan servicer market transfers, borrower risks during transfers, successor servicer practices, and applicable regulations.

topics.topic: PEAKS Loan Portfolio Transfer and Regulatory Violations
topics.evidence: Interrogation shifts to the specific PEAKS loan transfer from Access Group to Vervent/First Associates in 2011 and whether regulatory violations occurred.

topics.topic: Student loan servicing data transfer laws and regulations
topics.evidence: Questions and answers regarding state laws governing data transfers between loan servicers and whether regulations were violated in transferring PEAKS loan data to Vervent.

topics.topic: Deponent's criminal law experience
topics.evidence: Interrogation regarding deponent's past work and personal experience with criminal law, including a district attorney internship and jury service.

topics.topic: RICO statute experience and report findings
topics.evidence: Questions concerning deponent's familiarity with RICO in student loan matters and whether the deponent analyzed or offered opinions on a RICO enterprise in the report.

topics.topic: Report paragraph numbering and structure
topics.evidence: Inquiry regarding the omission of paragraph numbers after paragraph 8 in the deponent's expert report.

topics.topic: Background on for-profit colleges and higher education
topics.evidence: Questions addressing the report's background overview of higher education and for-profit institutions.

topics.topic: Overview and Analysis of For-Profit Colleges, ITT Student Debt, and Outcomes
topics.evidence: The witness discusses for-profit colleges, expertise regarding student loan debt at ITT, and the economic outcomes and degree value for ITT students.

topics.topic: ITT student economic outcomes, retention, and default rates
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding data on ITT students' economic outcomes, retention rates from the Senate HELP Committee report, and student loan default rates.

topics.topic: Valuation of ITT degrees and post-graduation earnings hypotheticals
topics.evidence: Questioning about whether ITT degrees had value, handling outlier post-graduation income increases, and analyzing aggregate versus individual outcomes.

topics.topic: ITT Graduate Salary Outcomes and Institutional Misrepresentations
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding whether high salaries for ITT graduates are outliers and how ITT misrepresented education quality, degree value, job placement rates, and graduate earnings.

topics.topic: Vervent Defendants' Awareness of ITT Misrepresentations and Student Loans
topics.evidence: Questions and answers about whether Vervent defendants were aware of ITT's misrepresentations when collecting loan payments, citing findings from CFPB and Senate committee reports.

topics.topic: Sources of evidence regarding ITT misrepresentations
topics.evidence: The witness details sources documenting ITT's misrepresentations, including the Senate HELP Committee Report and CFPB investigations into educational quality, accreditation value, and job placement rates.

topics.topic: Value of ITT degrees and post-graduation earnings hypotheticals
topics.evidence: Counsel questions the witness regarding whether an ITT graduate earning significantly higher post-graduation income would be an outlier, and the witness addresses degree value and data limitations.

topics.topic: Hypothetical regarding ITT graduate salary outcomes and outlier status
topics.evidence: Discussion questioning whether an ITT graduate increasing their earnings from minimum wage to $80,000 annually represents an outlier compared to typical graduate outcomes.

topics.topic: Vervent defendants' involvement in PEAKS loan origination
topics.evidence: Questions regarding the timeline of PEAKS loan origination and whether the Vervent defendants were involved prior to taking over servicing responsibilities in late 2011.

topics.topic: Vervent Defendants' Role in PEAKS Loan Origination and Student Recruitment
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding whether the Vervent defendants were involved in originating PEAKS loans or had any role in recruiting students to ITT.

topics.topic: Legality, Enforceability, and Collection Orders Concerning PEAKS Loans
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding the witness's opinions on PEAKS loans, legal determinations of enforceability including the CFPB settlement, and orders to cease collections.

topics.topic: Orders and Instructions Regarding PEAKS Loan Collections
topics.evidence: Witness and counsel discuss whether any court or governmental agency, including during the 2016 ITT bankruptcy, ordered or instructed that collections cease on PEAKS loans prior to the 2020 settlement.

topics.topic: Enforceability of PEAKS Loans and Document Defects
topics.evidence: Counsel questions the witness about their opinion on whether PEAKS loans were unenforceable, and the witness explains that while determining individual legal enforceability is outside their scope, material defects exist in the loan documentation that raise enforceability questions.

topics.topic: Enforceability of PEAKS Loans and Missing Documentation
topics.evidence: The witness discusses opinions on whether PEAKS loans are enforceable and valid, explaining that key origination documents and Truth in Lending Act disclosures appear to be missing.

topics.topic: Review of Access Group Disclosures and Regulations Regarding Vervent
topics.evidence: The examination addresses whether the witness reviewed disclosures held by Access Group, regulatory requirements for Vervent to possess disclosures, and the California Student Loan Servicing Law.

topics.topic: Scope of Report Regarding California Loan Servicing Law
topics.evidence: The witness is asked whether California loan servicing law was reviewed or opined upon in their expert report.

topics.topic: Vervent's Access to PEAKS Loan Documents and Interest Rates
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding PEAKS loan enforceability and whether Vervent possessed underlying loan documentation showing interest rates versus spreadsheet records.

topics.topic: Final Disclosures Provided to PEAKS Borrowers
topics.evidence: Questioning regarding whether required final disclosures were provided or sent to PEAKS loan borrowers.

topics.topic: PEAKS Loan Final Disclosures and Cancellation Rights
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding whether PEAKS borrowers received required final disclosures, and the resulting legal consequences, right to cancel, and loan enforceability.

topics.topic: Impact of missing disclosures on loan enforceability and right to cancel
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding whether a loan is enforceable if disclosures were never provided, a borrower's right to cancel, and the timeframe for receiving disclosures.

topics.topic: Post-origination factors, CFPB findings, and loan enforceability
topics.evidence: Questions regarding events after origination affecting loan enforceability, Consumer Financial Protection Bureau and Department of Education findings, and whether the CFPB settlement found fault with Vervent defendants.

topics.topic: Expert report findings on abusive recruiting and financial aid practices
topics.evidence: Counsel references page 11 of the witness's report concerning historical evidence of abusive recruiting and financial aid practices.

topics.topic: CFPB Settlement and PEAKS Loans
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding the CFPB settlement, the canceling of loans, and whether any Vervent defendants were found at fault regarding the PEAKS loans.

topics.topic: ITT Recruiting Practices and Government Student Loans
topics.evidence: Examination of the witness's report concerning historical reports of abusive recruiting and financial aid practices at ITT, and whether the federal government's continued provision of Title IV loans implies approval or indicates the lack of a fraudulent enterprise.

topics.topic: Knowledge of ITT's abusive practices and federal loan involvement
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding what was known by the community, whistleblowers, and the federal government about ITT's fraudulent practices and student loans.

topics.topic: CFPB investigations and findings regarding PEAKS program and Vervent defendants
topics.evidence: Examination of the 2012 CFPB Civil Investigative Demand, subsequent complaints, and whether any findings of wrongdoing were made against the Vervent defendants.

topics.topic: CFPB findings regarding Vervent defendants and PEAKS loans
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding whether the CFPB made any findings of wrongdoing against the Vervent defendants concerning their servicing of the PEAKS loans.

topics.topic: SEC investigation and findings regarding Vervent defendants
topics.evidence: Examination of whether the SEC made findings or took issue with the Vervent defendants regarding payments made on behalf of borrowers.

topics.topic: February 2014 CFPB suit against ITT
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding the February 2014 Consumer Financial Protection Bureau suit against ITT over high-pressure tactics and predatory loans.

topics.topic: CFPB suit against ITT and PEAKS loans
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding the February 2014 Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's suit against ITT, the related settlements, and Vervent's role as a servicer versus loan origination.

topics.topic: State attorneys general investigations into ITT
topics.evidence: Examination of the 2014 state attorneys general investigations into ITT for fraud and deceptive marketing and whether any findings implicated the Vervent defendants.

topics.topic: Findings regarding Vervent and ITT by investigators and the Department of Education
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding whether investigations made any findings of wrongdoing by Vervent, focusing instead on the behavior of ITT, and the role of the U.S. Department of Education regarding loan servicers.

topics.topic: Witness's professional background and familiarity with investigations into ITT and PEAKS
topics.evidence: Questioning of Ms. Yu regarding her professional experience with investigations, her lack of a personal role in the investigations into ITT and the PEAKS program, and whether an investigation implies wrongdoing.

topics.topic: Investigations into ITT and PEAKS Program
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding third-party investigations into ITT and the PEAKS program, whether investigations establish wrongdoing, and whether these investigations should have caused Vervent to stop servicing or collecting on the loans.

topics.topic: Functions of a Loan Servicer
topics.evidence: Discussion clarifying the roles and responsibilities of a loan servicer, including accepting payments, tracking borrower data, and acting as an interface between borrowers and loan holders.

topics.topic: Regulations on Servicing During School Investigations
topics.evidence: Questioning regarding whether statutes or regulations require a servicer to stop servicing loans upon learning of an investigation into a school.

topics.topic: Functions of student loan servicers
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding tracking borrower addresses, data, payments, and advising borrowers on loan options.

topics.topic: Regulations on servicers and loan enforceability
topics.evidence: Examination of whether statutes require a servicer to stop servicing loans due to school investigations and unfair practices regarding unenforceable loans.

topics.topic: Enforceability and settlement of PEAKS loans
topics.evidence: Discussion about when PEAKS loans were deemed unenforceable, the CFPB settlement in fall 2020, and evidence prior to that date.

topics.topic: Enforceability and timeline of PEAKS loans
topics.evidence: Discussion regarding whether court or governmental agency determinations were made prior to 2020, and whether the PEAKS loans were unenforceable at their outset due to lack of disclosures.

topics.topic: Vervent defendants' servicing of PEAKS loans
topics.evidence: Examination of whether the witness has an opinion on what would have happened if Vervent did not service the loans, and whether investigations noted any issues with Vervent's servicing.
